text: びくびく…　こわくて　ここに　かくれてるんだ…

structure.jp: ここに　かくれてるんだ…

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.explanation: The て form of a feeling word can give the reason for what follows. こわくて = 'I'm scared, so'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on right now; てる is the short spoken form. かくれてる = 'am hiding'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end explains the situation; んだ is its spoken form. かくれてるんだ = 'the thing is, I'm hiding'.
